clue.text: Rugby players finally reconciled on the quiet

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word players

parts.note: accounts that are reconciled are made even, balanced
something said on the quiet is said aside, out of others' hearing

explanation.surface: A rugby team finally makes up its differences in private.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rugby players' reads as the definition, but the players only lend their last letter; the definition is 'Rugby' alone, naming a version of the game.
explanation.definitionFit: The short game with teams of seven, known as sevens, is a recognised form of rugby union.

clue.text: Bar? Time to leave bar

indicators.note: to leave says the time letter departs from the following word

parts.note: a stave is a wooden bar or rod

explanation.surface: A cryptic pub question: is it time to leave the bar?
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'Bar' is the preposition meaning except; the second is a rod.
explanation.definitionFit: Save and bar both work as prepositions meaning except, as in 'all save one'.

clue.text: Supposedly plain article found in big house

indicators.note: found in says the article sits inside the large house

parts.note: a villa is a large country or suburban house
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A plain item turns up in a grand mansion.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanilla is slang for ordinary or plain, though the flavour itself is rich, hence 'supposedly'.

clue.text: I'm expected to handle late deliveries

definitions.text: I'm expected to handle late deliveries

parts.words: I'm expected to handle late deliveries
parts.note: in cricket a lower-order batsman is sent in near the close of play to face the last balls bowled, protecting better batsmen

explanation.surface: A postal worker on the late shift describes the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deliveries' suggests post, but they are balls bowled in cricket, a bat-and-ball game, late in the day's play.
explanation.definitionFit: The cricket role exists precisely to face the final overs of a day so a key batsman is spared.

clue.text: Attempts to remove one on board producing tension

indicators.note: on board means aboard a ship, so the shortened word goes inside the ship's letters

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, the vessel one is on board

indicators.note: to remove signals that the letter for one is taken out of the word for attempts

parts.note: tries are attempts
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Efforts to put someone ashore cause friction among the crew.
explanation.walkthrough: TRIES loses I to give TRES, which goes 'on board' SS.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress and tension are synonyms for strain, physical or mental.

clue.text: Face accommodating plea for help about power management

indicators.note: accommodating means holding within, so the face word wraps the rest

parts.note: a dial is the face of a clock or instrument

indicators.note: about means going round, so the distress call surrounds the power letter

parts.note: SOS is the distress signal
P is the abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: A face that takes a call for help concerning power supply control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Face' looks like a verb, but it is a clock face; 'management' is the definition, in the sense of things being at one's disposal.
explanation.definitionFit: Having something at your disposal means having control of it, so disposal can mean management or arrangement.

clue.text: Location that recalls mountain peaks

indicators.note: recalls is read as calls back, so the word for peaks runs in reverse

parts.note: tops are the peaks of mountains

explanation.surface: A place that brings summits to mind.
explanation.definitionFit: A spot is a particular place or site.

clue.text: Left cut-down picture in colonnade

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: cut-down means shortened, so the picture word loses its last letter

parts.note: an icon is a religious picture

explanation.surface: An abandoned, cropped photo found in a row of columns.
explanation.definitionFit: A portico is a porch or walkway roofed and supported by columns.

clue.text: Dance music on record requiring unknown application of science

parts.note: techno is electronic dance music
a log is a written record
Y is an unknown in algebra

explanation.surface: Club music on vinyl needs some unknown scientific know-how.
explanation.definitionFit: Technology is scientific knowledge put to practical use.

clue.text: Very popular revolutionary fashion? It's sharp stuff

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the word for fashion is reversed

parts.note: a rage is a craze or fashion

explanation.surface: A hugely popular radical style is said to be cutting-edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegar is a sour, acidic liquid, so sharp-tasting stuff.

clue.text: Critics not initially upset about a comic

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rearranged letters go round the a
upset means knocked over, so the remaining letters are rearranged
not initially says the word critics loses its opening letter

explanation.surface: Reviewers, not upset at first, are annoyed by a comedian.
explanation.walkthrough: CRITICS without C is RITICS; 'upset' gives STIRIC, which goes 'about' A.
explanation.definitionFit: Satiric writing mocks its targets humorously, so it is comic in a pointed way.

clue.text: Accumulate power from hoax accusation about article in France-Soir

indicators.note: about means around, so the two words surround the French article

parts.note: a trick is a hoax
a charge is a formal accusation
le is a French definite article, as in a Paris newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper story about a fake allegation gains energy.
explanation.walkthrough: France-Soir is a Paris daily paper; its article is the French LE.
explanation.definitionFit: To trickle charge is to top up a battery slowly and steadily, storing electrical energy.

clue.text: American to postulate getting covered in cream as example of physical discipline

indicators.note: getting covered in says the pieces are enclosed by the cream word

parts.note: lotion is a cream for the skin
to posit is to postulate

explanation.surface: An American theorises while being smeared with cream as part of a fitness regime.
explanation.definitionFit: The cross-legged seated posture of yoga is a classic exercise of bodily discipline.

clue.text: Crackpot to sunbathe and so on, with sea tossing

parts.note: to bask is to lie in the sun
etc is short for et cetera, and so on

indicators.note: a tossing sea is churned up, so its letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A madman sunbathes and so forth while the sea heaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Basket case is slang for someone mentally unhinged, a crazy person.

clue.text: Screen image showing Victor between a pair of Americans in front of pitch

indicators.note: in front of says the first part comes before the next
between puts the radio letter in the middle of the two letters

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for American, so two of them
Victor is V in the radio alphabet
pitch is tar, a black sticky substance

explanation.surface: A screen picture shows a man between two Yanks before a match.
explanation.definitionFit: An avatar is the icon or figure representing a user on a computer display.

clue.text: Support aircraft manoeuvres?

definitions.meaning: a plane can bank, tilting to turn, and roll, rotating on its axis: two manoeuvres side by side

explanation.surface: Backing for aerial stunts.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is whimsical, hence the question mark: two flying moves joined.
explanation.definitionFit: To bankroll a venture is to finance it, giving it monetary backing.

clue.text: Close of prayer supporting seamen in biblical text is a graceful thing

indicators.note: in says the pieces sit inside the biblical text letters

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament

indicators.note: in a down entry, supporting means lying below the other piece

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
amen is said at the end of a prayer

explanation.surface: An amen ending a prayer under sailors in scripture is elegant.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornament is a decorative object, something that adds grace or beauty.

clue.text: Gently nudge dog, getting left piece of hair

parts.note: in snooker or bowls, to kiss is to touch another ball lightly
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: Prodding a dog leaves someone with a tuft of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiss-curl is a small flat curl worn on the forehead or cheek.

clue.text: Place engulfed in swell display of extravagance

indicators.note: engulfed in says the place letters are swallowed by the swell word

parts.note: a surge is a swell of the sea
Pl is the abbreviation for Place in addresses

explanation.surface: A spot swamped by a big wave makes a lavish show.
explanation.definitionFit: A splurge is a lavish spending spree or ostentatious show.

clue.text: Sailor recalled attempts to cuddle a dolphin's head

indicators.note: to cuddle means to hug, so the reversed word wraps the rest
recalled means called back, so the word for attempts runs backwards

parts.note: goes are attempts, as in 'have a go'

indicators.note: head picks the opening letter of dolphin

explanation.surface: A mariner remembers trying to hug a dolphin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' turns GOES into SEOG, which holds A and D.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea dog is an old idiom for an experienced sailor.

clue.text: River suffered with a Parisian leaving

indicators.note: leaving says the French article departs from the word for suffered

parts.note: to undergo is to suffer, so underwent means suffered
un is French for a

explanation.surface: A river suffered as a Frenchman went away.
explanation.walkthrough: The Derwent is the name of several English rivers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derwent is a river, e.g. in Derbyshire and in Cumbria, England.

clue.text: TV boss about to eye up angle

indicators.note: about means around, so the boss's letters surround the eyeing word

parts.note: DG is the Director-General of the BBC, Britain's public broadcaster
to ogle is to eye up lustfully

explanation.surface: A television chief is about to give someone the eye from a certain angle.
explanation.definitionFit: A dog-leg is a sharp bend, as in a road or golf hole: an angle.

clue.text: All meet after disruption, one woman excepted? I don't believe it

indicators.note: after disruption means once broken up, so the letters of all meet are rearranged

parts.note: one woman left out reads as the phrase not her

explanation.surface: Everyone gathers after a disturbance except one woman, prompting disbelief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one woman excepted' reads as NOT HER, after the rearranged ALLMEET.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a sceptical retort to a tall story, expressing disbelief.

clue.text: Happy people appearing gutted — excessive advertising?

indicators.note: gutted means with insides removed, so only the outer letters of each word stay

explanation.surface: Happy people look devastated by aggressive marketing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gutted' is British slang for bitterly disappointed, contrasting with 'Happy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hype is exaggerated promotion and publicity.

clue.text: Order selection by artist from the East

indicators.note: reading from the east means right to left, so the artist's letters run backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a recognised artist
a range is a selection of goods

explanation.surface: A choice of goods by an Eastern painter is put in order.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange things is to put them in order.

clue.text: Delicate stuff about Republican leading US city crime

indicators.note: leading means going in front of what follows
about means around, so the fabric word surrounds the party letter

parts.note: lace is a delicate fabric
NY is New York

explanation.surface: Fine fabric around a Republican from New York suggests a crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Larceny is the legal term for theft.

clue.text: Detectives certainly on trail of crime ultimately

indicators.note: on the trail of means following, so this word comes after
ultimately points to the final letter of crime

parts.note: yes is an emphatic affirmative, certainly

explanation.surface: Investigators are definitely following a crime to its end.
explanation.definitionFit: Private eyes is slang for private detectives.

clue.text: Step around vegetable with tip of leaf showing large insect

indicators.note: around says the step word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a stage is a step in a process
beet is a root vegetable

indicators.note: tip of picks the first letter of leaf

explanation.surface: A gardener walks round a vegetable patch, a leaf tip revealing a big bug.
explanation.definitionFit: The stag beetle is a large European beetle with antler-like jaws.
